questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the arrows.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the organ that fills the field.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The duodenum is the first portion of the small intestine and has villi like the rest of the small intestine. These mucus-secreting, submucosal glands are found only in the duodenal portion of the small intestine.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the double arrow.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Villi are projections of the mucosa, which contain a core of lamina propria, and are covered by a simple columnar epithelium with goblet cells.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure outlined in this image.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Brunner's glands are mucus-secreting glands located in the submucosa. Brunner's glands are present only in the duodenal portion of the small intestine and, thus, are diagnostic for this region of small intestine.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the organ that fills the field.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The small intestine displays villi, which are projections of the mucosa that contain a core of lamina propria. The small intestine is lined by a simple columnar epithelium with microvilli and goblet cells.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. A Peyer's patch is an accumulation of lymphoid nodules in the lamina propria of the ileum. Lymphoid tissue can occur in this location along the entire digestive tract; however, the term Peyer's patch is reserved for these large accumulations in the ileum. Accumulations of lymphoid tissue appear highly basophilic due to the presence of large numbers of lymphocytes.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. A plica circularis is a circular fold extending around the entire inner circumference of the small intestine. Each plica has a central core of submucosa covered by the overlying mucosa with its villi. In contrast, a villus has a core of lamina propria that is overlain by the simple columnar epithelium lining the small intestine.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the layer indicated by the double arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The muscularis externa is the outer muscular layer of the digestive tract and usually consists of inner circular and outer longitudinal layers of smooth muscle. Beyond the muscularis externa is the adventitia which is some regions of the digestive tract is covered by a mesothelium (visceral peritoneum); it which case it forms a serosa.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the organ than fills the field.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The large intestine has a flat surface with numerous straight, simple tubular glands extending into the lamina propria. No villi are present.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the layer indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The muscularis mucosae is the deepest layer of the mucosa, lying adjacent to the submucosa. questoes.enunciado: Identify the region of the digestive tract that fills the field.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure outlined in this image.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the organ that fills the field.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The parotid salivary gland is a compound acinar gland and, thus, no mucus tubules are present. questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Intercalated ducts are the smallest ducts in salivary glands and generally are smaller than the surrounding acini. They are composed of a low cuboidal epithelium. Striated ducts are lined by a taller epithelium with basal striations.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the organ that fills the field.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The submandibular salivary gland is a mixed gland, containing both serous-secreting acini and mucus-secreting tubules.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the organ that fills the field.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The pancreas is both an exocrine and endocrine gland. questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the double arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. questoes.enunciado: Identify the organ that fills the field.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The liver is composed of interlacing plates of large, cuboidal-shaped hepatocytes that alternate with hepatic sinusoids The sinusoids are discontinuous sinusoidal capillaries that drain into central veins, one of which is seen in the center of this image.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the double arrow.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The central vein lies at the center of the classic liver lobule and receives blood from the liver sinusoids. Central veins anastomose to form the hepatic veins which exit the liver.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The portal triad of the liver contains the hepatic artery, hepatic portal vein and bile duct. questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the double arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Filiform papilla are flame-shaped structures located over the entire dorsum and lateral surfaces of the tongue. They consist of a keratinized stratified squamous epithelium, which overlies a core of connective tissue.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the organ that fills the field.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the specific region of the organ indicated by the double arrow.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the specific region of the organ that fills the field.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the cells indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The parietal cells secrete hydrochloric acid and are found mostly in the upper part of the gastric gland. They have abundant reddish cytoplasm with a centrally located nucleus. The other major cell type in the gland, the chief cell, has a very basophilic cytoplasm.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the blue rectangles.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the cells indicated by the arrows.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the cells indicated by the arrows.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the region that fills the field.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the layer indicated by the arrows.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures outlined in this image.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the cells indicated by the oval.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the cells indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Enteroendocrine cells are located throughout the GI tract and are a component of the diffuse neuroendocrine system of cells and tissues. questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the double arrow.
